description_md:
## What You Get

- 
Complete MCP Setup Guide: A clear, step-by-step Scribe reference document so you can effortlessly set up your MCP server locally using Docker

- 
Warp Terminal Link: Direct access to the powerful terminal used in the video, making your installation and debugging process smooth

- 
Visual Overview in Miro: An easy-to-follow visual breakdown of the MCP connection logic and workflow, ensuring you're always clear on what's happening behind the scenes

- 
Ready-to-Use Terminal Request Sample: Just copy-paste the provided request to instantly configure your MCP server with your Pinecone Assistant credentials

- 
Demo Testing Resources: Two comprehensive demo asset bundles:
- 
Demo 1: Multiple PDF files perfect for quick and easy MCP connection testing

- 
Demo 2: A meticulously crafted, 400-page PDF detailing every automation method and software as of December 2024, along with 6 powerful JSON bundles derived from hundreds of automation blueprints—ready for import directly into Make.com (can't find this anywhere else!)

💖 This entire setup—including video creation, resource compilation, and custom demo bundles—took our team over 20 hours to perfect. Supporting the channel would genuinely mean a lot!
Or better yet, join the Early AI-dopters community for exclusive access and deeper insights.
